title: Verify that a visitor reaches the Economic Research page from the main menu and sees the library
description: The listing page is published with at least one published report.

steps.action: Open the Qatar Chamber website in English
steps.expected: Home page loads with the main menu visible

steps.action: Click 'Our Services' in the main menu
steps.expected: 'Our Services' dropdown expands

steps.action: Click 'Economic Research' in the dropdown
steps.expected: The Economic Research page loads

steps.action: Observe the page from hero to footer
steps.expected: Breadcrumb 'Home > Services' renders over the maroon hero gradient; the hero shows eyebrow 'Research & Studies', title 'Economic Research', its description and the hero banner image; the quick facts read Content / Market Intelligence, Coverage / All Sectors, Audience / Businesses & Investors and Source / Official Publications; the index lists 01 Overview and 02 Research library; Section 01 renders its badge 'About the service' and Section 02 its badge 'Research library' above the heading 'Published research and studies' and the report cards

title: Verify that clicking a section-index entry scrolls to that section and marks it active
description: The PBI states the section index is sticky.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the sticky index visible

steps.action: Click '02 Research library' in the sticky section index
steps.expected: The viewport scrolls to Section 02 and its heading is in view

steps.action: Observe the viewport and the index
steps.expected: The '02 Research library' entry is marked active and the index stays sticky in the viewport

steps.action: Scroll back up and observe the index
steps.expected: The active marker follows the section currently in view rather than staying on Section 02

title: Verify that selecting the other section-index entry moves the active marker off the first
description: Repeat pass on the index control with only two sections.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with both index entries

steps.action: Click '02 Research library' in the index
steps.expected: Viewport moves to Section 02 and that entry is active

steps.action: Click '01 Overview' in the index
steps.expected: Viewport moves to Section 01 Overview

steps.action: Inspect both index entries
steps.expected: Exactly one entry is marked active ('01 Overview') and Section 02 has returned to its default style

title: Verify that clicking a report card opens that report in the preview view
description: The PBI states the card opens the same report in preview mode and the detail view shows its summary, metadata and key topics.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Scroll to Section 02 Research library
steps.expected: The library renders one card per published report

steps.action: Note the title and publish date on the first card
steps.expected: The card shows its thumbnail, title, short description, publish date and a Download PDF button

steps.action: Click that card
steps.expected: The report opens in the preview view showing that same report — its title and publish date match the card the visitor clicked, not another report's

title: Verify that Download PDF is also reachable from the report preview view
description: The preview view is the second surface the visitor can download from; a card-only download would leave it untested.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Click a report card to open the preview view
steps.expected: The preview view opens for that report

steps.action: Locate the download action in the preview
steps.expected: A download action is present in the preview view for the same report

steps.action: Click it and open the downloaded file
steps.expected: The downloaded file is the document attached to that report in the CMS

title: Verify that the language toggle switches the whole page and the report cards between English and Arabic
description: The PBI requires all content — titles, descriptions, dates, buttons — to display in the selected language with correct LTR / RTL layout.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads left-to-right with English content

steps.action: Click the AR language toggle in the header
steps.expected: The page reloads in Arabic

steps.action: Inspect the hero, quick facts, section index and both sections
steps.expected: Every label, section badge, section title and body renders in Arabic, right-to-left, with no English text left in a translated field

steps.action: Inspect a report card and click the EN toggle to switch back
steps.expected: The card's title and short description render in Arabic, the publish date is localised and the Download PDF button label is Arabic; switching back returns the page to English left-to-right

title: Verify that the breadcrumb links on the Economic Research page navigate to their targets
description: Verifies the two breadcrumb segments. Figma frame 2972:114643 carries the placeholder value 'Hcvxcxvcome' on the Breadcrumb component — see Open Risk R-6.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the hero rendered

steps.action: Inspect the breadcrumb in the hero
steps.expected: Breadcrumb shows a home icon, 'Home', a chevron-right separator, then 'Services' — and no placeholder text such as 'Hcvxcxvcome'

steps.action: Click the 'Home' breadcrumb link
steps.expected: Browser navigates to the Qatar Chamber home page

steps.action: Navigate back and click the 'Services' breadcrumb link
steps.expected: Browser navigates to the Services landing page

title: Verify that an active quick-fact tile renders with its full content in the configured position
description: Asserts ST-6 at element level for the third quick-facts tile.

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as a Site Content Editor and open the Economic Research page record and confirm the third quick-facts tile is Active with Display Order 3
steps.expected: The tile is Active with Display Order 3

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Scroll to the quick-facts strip
steps.expected: The strip renders its active tiles in order

steps.action: Inspect the third tile
steps.expected: The third tile shows its icon, the label 'Audience' and the value 'Businesses & Investors', matching the values stored in the CMS

title: Verify that the Economic Research page renders correctly in light mode

steps.expected: Light mode is active

steps.expected: Page loads with no visual defects

steps.action: Inspect the page background, header and section index

steps.action: Inspect a report card and its Download PDF button

steps.action: Set the browser or site appearance to dark mode
steps.expected: Dark mode is active

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with no visual defects and no unstyled light-mode remnants

steps.action: Inspect the page background, header and section index
steps.expected: The page and header adopt the dark palette and every index label, section heading and body text remains legible against it

steps.action: Inspect a report card, its thumbnail and its Download PDF button
steps.expected: Report cards adopt their dark surface, the thumbnail image is not washed out or inverted, and the Download PDF button keeps a readable contrast

title: Verify that the English Economic Research page renders left-to-right with the designed copy
description: Asserts LNG-1 against the English desktop Figma frame 2972:114643.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads left-to-right

steps.action: Inspect the hero and quick-facts strip
steps.expected: The hero shows 'Research & Studies' above 'Economic Research' with its description constrained to its designed width and the banner image beside it; the quick facts read Content, Coverage, Audience and Source

steps.action: Inspect the section index and Section 01

title: Verify that the Arabic Economic Research page renders right-to-left with Arabic copy throughout

description: Asserts LNG-2 on the detail surface, which the page-level case does not reach.

steps.action: Click a report card to open the preview view
steps.expected: The preview view opens for that report

steps.action: Inspect the title, summary, metadata and publish date
steps.expected: The report's title, summary and metadata render in Arabic, right-aligned, and the publish date is localised for Arabic

steps.action: Inspect the download action
steps.expected: The download action's label renders in Arabic and serves the same PDF as the English view

steps.action: Inspect the report cards
steps.expected: Each card keeps its thumbnail, title, description, publish date and Download PDF button readable, stacking them if the row no longer fits

title: Verify that the Economic Research page renders correctly at mobile viewport width

title: Verify that a failure to load the Economic Research page shows the standard site error page
description: Covers the unhappy delivery path so a broken page does not surface a raw server error to the visitor.

steps.action: Request the Economic Research URL with the content service unavailable
steps.expected: The request completes

steps.action: Observe the response
steps.expected: The visitor sees the site's standard error page with the site header and footer, not a raw stack trace, a Liferay diagnostic screen or a blank page

steps.action: Request an Economic Research report URL that does not exist
steps.expected: The request completes

steps.action: Observe that response
steps.expected: The visitor sees the site's standard not-found page in the current language

title: Verify that the library's card order is stable and repeatable across reloads
description: The PBI defines no Display Order on the Research Report record and never states the listing order — see Open Risk R-18. This case records the order the build applies and asserts it is deterministic.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the library rendered

steps.action: Record the order of every report card in the Research library
steps.expected: The card order is captured

steps.action: Reload the page three times, recording the order each time
steps.expected: The order is identical on all three reloads — no card moves position and none is dropped or duplicated

steps.action: Compare the recorded orders against the reports' Publish Dates in the CMS
steps.expected: The order follows one stated rule, most plausibly Publish Date descending, and that rule is recorded so the build's behaviour can be confirmed against the BA's intent
